# Fixture P3-PASS-ANOMALY Storyboard

01. The hikers find a painted boundary stone and a brass bell beside the path.
02. A boot crosses the line; the bell rings immediately. The others stay behind the line.
03. They test the rule with a pole from the safe side; no ring occurs until it crosses.
04. A friend is lost in the fog. An uses the pole to ring the bell from behind the boundary.
05. The sound returns from beyond the fog and the friend walks back to the group.
06. The hikers paint the boundary so later visitors can see it before reaching the bell.
